metric_rules: all metrics are computed only on untouched target-domain holdout
no metric tuning after target inspection
classification metrics apply only when recovered/failed labels exist
rank metrics are the primary decision path

frozen_tolerances.confidence_interval_method: bootstrap or analytic but frozen before runner implementation

notes: The metric set is intentionally broader than a single scalar so the benchmark can fail honestly.
The transfer-gap diagnostic is only secondary; the decision path remains holdout ranking.
